description: Stronger whitening at the same update norm and no extra cost: swap the fixed quintic coefficients (3.4445, -4.7750, 2.0315) used in all 3 NS iterations for three per-iteration Polar Express triples. Compute them with optimal_composition(num_iters=3, l=ℓ) from arxiv 2505.16932, where ℓ is the 5th-percentile smallest-singular-value ratio measured in drafts/ on the tip's real normalized momentum matrices (seed 0, steps 0/100/end, all groups). Apply the published safety scaling and do not truncate a longer list. After NS, rescale each group's output to the Frobenius norm the current NS3 output would have. Compute this cheaply as a per-group constant measured in drafts/, or online as the ratio of norms if that is cheap, so only the spectrum shape changes and the step size does not. Base: E058; everything else is unchanged. Gate in drafts/: the fraction of singular values >0.5 after the new NS must be >= NS3's, and the max singular value must be <= 1.3. Re-warm both Muon variants and run debug_nan.py under max-autotune-no-cudagraphs.
